query: Show the coal flow from wagon or track hopper to boiler bunker and include relevant diagrams.

key_text_evidence.title: What is the fundamental principle of a Track Hopper?
key_text_evidence.excerpt: What is the fundamental principle of a Track Hopper? A The wagon is physically rotated to empty coal B Bottom doors open and coal falls by gravity into pit below C A vacuum system draws coal out of the wagon D Hydraulic rams tilt the wagon sideways
key_text_evidence.citation: [What is the fundamental principle of a Track Hopper?, concept: what-is-the-fundamental-principle-of-a-track-hopper]

key_text_evidence.title: The Track Hopper area looks quiet between unloadings. Is it safe to approach the grizzly edge?
key_text_evidence.excerpt: The Track Hopper area looks quiet between unloadings. Is it safe to approach the grizzly edge? A Yes — if no wagon is on the track, it is safe B Yes — the feeder stops automatically between unloading cycles C No — feeder may still run, arch could collapse, bars may be wet, dust may be present underground D Yes, but only briefly and with both hands free

key_text_evidence.title: Wagon Tippler से Belt Conveyor तक का Flow
key_text_evidence.excerpt: Wagon Tippler से Belt Conveyor तक का Flow Step | Equipment | Function ; 1 | Wagon Tippler / Track Hopper | Coal wagon को empty करता है — hopper में dump ; 2 | Hopper + Vibratory/Apron Feeder | Controlled rate पर coal को Belt No. 1 पर feed करता है ; 3 | Belt Conveyor No. 1 (BC-1) | Coal को Crusher House तक ले जाती है ; 4 | Crusher House | Coal को ≤50 mm तक crush करता है ; 5 | CHP Conveyors | Crushed coal को Coal Yard / Bunkers तक पहुँचाती हैं ; 6 | Bunker → Mill → Boiler | Generation cycle शुरू होती है

key_text_evidence.title: System Flow Integration – Coal का पूरा सफर

key_text_evidence.title: The complete coal journey
key_text_evidence.excerpt: The complete coal journey 1 Coal Wagon Bottom doors open over track hopper 2 Track Hopper Pit Coal falls by gravity into underground cavity 3 Grizzly Screen Steel bars filter out oversized material 4 Feeder System Extracts coal at controlled, steady rate 5 Belt Conveyor Carries coal to crusher / yard / bunkers
